# spirl_application (Resource)

Registers a manual (customer-created) application in the Defakto Ledger. Discovered applications are created by scanners and cannot be managed by this resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Register a manual application in the Defakto Ledger.
resource "spirl_application" "billing_api" {
  name             = "billing-api"
  short_name       = "Billing API"
  agentic          = false
  owner            = "team-payments@example.com"
  runtime_platform = "Kubernetes"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique, immutable name for the application within the organization, between 1 and 512 characters. Changing it destroys and recreates the resource.

### Optional

- `agentic` (Boolean) Whether this application is an AI agent. Defaults to `false`.
- `owner` (String) Owner of the application, e.g. an email, at most 255 characters. Omit to leave the application without an owner.
- `runtime_platform` (String) Runtime platform the application runs on, e.g. `Kubernetes`, at most 255 characters. Omit to leave it unset.
- `short_name` (String) UI-friendly display name, between 1 and 512 characters. Defaults to `name` when not set. Once set, removing it from configuration retains the last value rather than reverting to `name`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) An RFC3339 timestamp for when the application was created
- `created_by` (String) The actor that created the application
- `id` (String) The unique identifier for the application
- `origin` (String) How the application came to exist. Always `MANUAL` for resources managed here.
- `updated_at` (String) An RFC3339 timestamp for when the application was last updated

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/bin/bash

# Application import uses the application id.
terraform import spirl_application.billing_api ast-1a2b3c4d5e
```
